sourceStatus: Separately owned Moving Edges geometry, fixed before image generation. Artwork is not geometry or gameplay qualification.

levels.name: Terrace Stitch
levels.description: Reveal 68%. Three unequal stepped terraces leave a central stitch and wider outer returns. A contour patrol follows the field boundary as you capture. The dormant rover warns when its cell becomes claimed, then moves inside claimed ground: a completed cut is a new decision, not permanent shelter. Try the north stitch or the lower terrace first. The extra life is an optional detour. Walls cannot reconnect a cut; each closure stops the craft until a fresh direction.

levels.name: Survey Wheel
levels.description: Reveal 70%. An off-center wall hub and four separated spokes divide unequal sectors. The hub is not a cut endpoint. Two contour patrols circulate in opposite directions; watch both before choosing a new return. Compare securing the outer sectors with stitching across the open gaps. A field interceptor warns before committing to its marked direction. The small eastern patch slows movement; the remote enemy-slow pickup is optional. Each closure stops movement until a fresh direction.

levels.name: Breakwater Return
levels.description: Reveal 70%. Two offset breakwaters shelter a broad bay, with an open return corridor on the right and a small western cove. Two eroders warn at vulnerable claimed cells before reopening them. Keep a return available, then decide whether to repair the bay or secure the outer strip first. The original outer border remains safe from erosion; the enemies still threaten contact. Recapturing an old cell restores coverage without earning that cell score twice. The cove extra life is optional. Walls cannot close a cut, and each capture requires a fresh direction to continue.
